mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a builder for my guest home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a builder for your guest home, prioritize experience with ADU construction, local knowledge of permitting processes in San Diego County, and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Look for transparent pricing, clear communication, and a comprehensive contract. Check their licensing, insurance, and client references. A builder who understands the nuances of local regulations and can guide you through each step, from design to final inspection, will ensure a smoother and more successful project outcome. Zen Tiny Homes emphasizes these factors in our client relationships.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a builder with ADU experience, local permitting knowledge, and transparent practices. Verify their licensing, insurance, and client references to ensure a smooth project.
